caseTitle.zh: 培養箱裡變色的小瓶子
caseTitle.en: The little vial that changed colour

condition.zh: 感染管制 · 滅菌失敗召回

tagline.zh: 看不見的細菌，靠看得見的紀錄抓住
tagline.en: Invisible germs are caught by visible records

roles.zh: 輪調護理師（消毒供應中心）

desc.zh: 第一次輪到消毒供應中心：讀指示劑、追鍋次、打召回電話。同事在去污區倒下的時候，你還是護理師。
desc.en: Your first rotation in sterile processing: read the indicators, trace the loads, make the recall calls. When a colleague collapses in decontamination, you are still a nurse.

desc.zh: 培養箱、清洗消毒機、包裝台的放大鏡。器械清單上少一把鉗子的時候，你是第一個發現的人。
desc.en: The incubator, the washer-disinfector, the magnifier at the packing table. When a clamp is missing from the tray list, you are the first to notice.

role.zh: 消毒供應中心護理長（師傅）

about.zh: 脖子上掛著一個放大鏡。讀滅菌鍋的列印紙像在讀詩，一行一行念。
about.en: A magnifier hangs round her neck. She reads sterilizer printouts like poetry, line by line, aloud.

about.zh: 在最熱的去污區穿全套防護。愛講冷笑話，說這樣可以降溫。今天早餐沒吃。
about.en: Works in full protective kit in the hottest room, decontamination. Tells bad jokes, claims they cool the place down. Skipped breakfast today.

about.zh: 器械清單背得比電話號碼熟。少一把鉗子，她隔著包布都感覺得到。
about.en: Knows tray lists better than phone numbers. She can sense a missing clamp through the wrap.

about.zh: 說話很慢，寫字很快。她說：召回不是丟臉，是系統在運作。
about.en: Speaks slowly, writes fast. Her saying: a recall isn't a disgrace; it's the system working.

role.zh: 開刀房流動護理師（電話）

about.zh: 今天第二台是人工髖關節。她的口頭禪：包布打開之前，什麼都還來得及。
about.en: Today's second case is a hip replacement. Her motto: until the wrap is opened, there's still time.

about.zh: 換藥前一定先看包外的指示膠帶。今天她看到包布摸起來是濕的。
about.en: Always checks the indicator tape before a dressing change. Today the wrap feels damp under her fingers.

role.zh: 七十六歲，今天換髖關節

about.zh: 虛構教學個案。退休公車司機，跌倒後髖關節磨損得厲害。他只想快點能走去公園下棋。
about.en: Fictional teaching case. A retired bus driver whose hip wore badly after a fall. All he wants is to walk to the park for chess again.

plain.zh: 全院用過的器械送回來清洗、檢查、包裝、滅菌、儲存，再送出去的地方。開刀房的每一把鉗子都經過這裡。
plain.en: Where the whole hospital's used instruments come back to be cleaned, inspected, packed, sterilised, stored and sent out again. Every clamp in the operating theatre passes through it.

plain.zh: 每天第一鍋空鍋跑的測試，看蒸氣能不能把空氣完全趕出去。測試紙顏色均勻改變才算通過。
plain.en: A test run in an empty chamber first thing each day to show the steam drives all the air out. The sheet must change colour evenly to pass.

plain.zh: 包外膠帶和包內指示卡，遇到滅菌條件會變色。它告訴你「這包有經過」，不保證細菌都死了。
plain.en: The tape outside and the card inside a pack, which change colour under sterilising conditions. They say “this pack went through”, not “every germ is dead”.

plain.zh: 裝著很耐熱的細菌孢子的小瓶子，跟著滅菌鍋跑一次再培養。孢子沒長是過關；變色長菌，代表那一鍋可能沒滅好。
plain.en: A small vial of very heat-resistant bacterial spores that runs through the sterilizer and is then incubated. No growth is a pass; a colour change means that load may not have been sterilised.

plain.zh: 發現某一鍋可能沒滅菌成功時，把那一鍋送出去的包全部找回來、隔離、重新處理，並通知用過的單位。
plain.en: When a load may not have been sterilised, every pack from it is traced, brought back, quarantined and reprocessed, and every unit that used one is told.

plain.zh: 每一包都有條碼：哪一鍋、哪一天、誰包的、送到哪裡、用在哪個病人。召回時靠它在幾分鐘內找到每一包。
plain.en: Every pack carries a barcode: which load, which day, who packed it, where it went, which patient it was used on. In a recall it finds every pack within minutes.

plain.zh: 把器械上的血、組織、黏液清乾淨，再消毒。沒洗乾淨的地方，滅菌也滅不到。
plain.en: Removing blood, tissue and mucus from instruments, then disinfecting them. Wherever cleaning fails, sterilising fails too.

plain.zh: 剪刀和鉗子兩片交叉的那個關節，最容易卡血。清洗時一定要打開。
plain.en: The joint where the two halves of scissors and clamps cross; the place blood hides most. Always open it for cleaning.

plain.zh: 滅菌後包布還是濕的。水會把外面的細菌吸進去，所以濕包一律當作污染，退回重做。
plain.en: A pack still damp after sterilisation. Moisture wicks germs in from outside, so a wet pack is always treated as contaminated and reprocessed.

plain.zh: 依器械碰到身體哪裡分三類：進入無菌組織的要滅菌；碰到黏膜的要高層次消毒；只碰到完整皮膚的清潔消毒即可。
plain.en: Instruments sorted by what they touch: those entering sterile tissue must be sterilised; those touching mucous membranes need high-level disinfection; those touching only intact skin need cleaning and low-level disinfection.

plain.zh: 無菌包能不能用，看的不是放了幾天，而是有沒有發生事件：破損、潮濕、掉地上、封口打開。
plain.en: Whether a sterile pack is usable depends not on how many days it has sat, but on events: a tear, damp, a drop to the floor, a broken seal.

plain.zh: 每一盤器械附的清單，寫著每一把的名字和數量。包裝時一件一件對，少一件就要追。
plain.en: The list with each instrument tray naming every piece and the count. At packing it's checked item by item; anything missing gets chased.

text.zh: 像一台很認真的洗碗機：預洗、酵素洗、主洗、熱水消毒、乾燥。器械要打開關節、不能疊太滿。
text.en: Like a very diligent dishwasher: pre-wash, enzyme wash, main wash, thermal disinfection, drying. Instruments go in with joints open and never overloaded.

text.zh: 用飽和蒸氣、壓力和時間殺死所有微生物。每一鍋都有列印紙：溫度、壓力、時間，護理長一行一行念。
text.en: Saturated steam, pressure and time kill every microbe. Each load prints a record of temperature, pressure and time, which Sister Wei reads line by line.

text.zh: 小瓶子插進去培養，到時間讀顏色。旁邊一定放一支沒滅菌的對照組，證明孢子本來是活的。
text.en: Vials go in to incubate and their colour is read when due. An unsterilised control always sits beside them to prove the spores were alive to begin with.

text.zh: 每一把器械在放大燈下看：關節、齒縫、絕緣層。對著器械清單一件一件放，放進包內指示卡，再包兩層。
text.en: Every instrument goes under the magnifier: joints, teeth, insulation. Placed piece by piece against the tray list, with an internal indicator card, then double-wrapped.

text.zh: 乾燥、乾淨、少人進出。先進先出，拿取前看包裝有沒有破、濕、掉落過。
text.en: Dry, clean, little traffic. First in, first out; before taking a pack, check for tears, damp or a fall.

text.zh: 在開刀房的布單袋裡找到的。小鄧把它放回盤子裡，對著器械清單打了一個勾，說：歡迎回家。
text.en: Found in a theatre linen bag. Deng puts it back in its tray, ticks the tray list and says: welcome home.

name.en: Four kinds of evidence, each saying one thing

text.zh: 物理監測（列印紙上的溫度壓力時間）說「機器設定對了」；波威-狄克測試說「空氣趕乾淨了」；化學指示劑說「這一包遇過滅菌條件」；生物指示劑說「最耐熱的孢子都死了」。只有生物指示劑直接證明殺菌。任何一項失敗，都不能用其他項的「通過」來抵銷。植入物那一鍋，要等生物指示劑的結果才放行。
text.en: Physical monitoring (the printed temperature, pressure and time) says “the machine was set right”; the Bowie-Dick test says “the air was driven out”; a chemical indicator says “this pack met sterilising conditions”; a biological indicator says “even the toughest spores died”. Only the biological indicator directly proves killing. A failure in any one cannot be cancelled by a pass in another. A load containing implants is released only after its biological indicator result.

text.zh: 生物指示劑陽性：先當作真的失敗。這台滅菌鍋停用；用追溯系統找出上次合格以後的每一鍋、每一包、送到哪裡；還沒用的立刻攔下隔離、重新處理；已經用在病人身上的，交給感染管制和主治醫師評估、通知、追蹤；查原因（裝載方式、蒸氣品質、指示劑處理）；重新測試合格才恢復使用。每一通電話記下時間和對象，下一班才接得住。
text.en: A positive biological indicator is treated as a real failure. Take that sterilizer out of service; use traceability to find every load since the last pass, every pack, and where it went; stop and quarantine unused packs for reprocessing; for packs already used on patients, infection control and the treating doctors assess, inform and follow up; investigate causes (loading, steam quality, indicator handling); return the sterilizer to use only after it retests clean. Log the time and person for every call so the next shift can pick it up.

name.zh: 斯伯丁分類：碰到哪裡，就要多乾淨

text.zh: 關鍵器械（進入無菌組織或血管：手術器械、植入物）必須滅菌；半關鍵器械（碰到黏膜或破損皮膚：內視鏡、喉頭鏡片）至少高層次消毒；非關鍵器械（只碰完整皮膚：血壓計袖帶、聽診器）清潔加低層次消毒。所有層次的第一步都一樣：先洗乾淨。
text.en: Critical items (entering sterile tissue or blood vessels: surgical instruments, implants) must be sterilised; semi-critical items (touching mucous membranes or broken skin: endoscopes, laryngoscope blades) need at least high-level disinfection; non-critical items (touching only intact skin: blood pressure cuffs, stethoscopes) need cleaning and low-level disinfection. At every level the first step is the same: clean it first.

note.zh: 測試過關；昨天的小瓶子變色了
note.en: Test passed; yesterday's vial changed colour

lines.zh: 清晨六點半。滅菌鍋的門打開，一陣熱氣。魏護理長拿起放大鏡。
lines.en: Half past six. The sterilizer door opens on a wave of heat. Sister Wei lifts her magnifier.

lines.zh: 每天第一鍋空鍋跑波威-狄克測試。你看測試紙，顏色均不均勻？
lines.en: Every day the first cycle runs empty for the Bowie-Dick test. Look at the sheet: is the colour change even?

lines.zh: 整張都均勻變深，中間沒有淡的一塊。
lines.en: Evenly darkened all over, no pale patch in the middle.

lines.zh: 過關。空氣趕乾淨了。可是這只說了一句話。真正說「細菌死了」的，在培養箱裡。
lines.en: Pass. The air was driven out. But that's only one sentence. The one that says “the germs are dead” is in the incubator.

lines.zh: 昨天下午三號鍋的生物指示劑，時間到了。去讀。
lines.en: Yesterday afternoon's biological indicator from sterilizer three is due. Go and read it.

q.zh: 找到生物指示劑培養箱

post.zh: 對照組變黃了，代表孢子是活的……可是三號鍋那一支，也變黃了。
post.en: The control has turned yellow, so the spores were alive… but the vial from sterilizer three has turned yellow too.
Positive. Treat it as a real failure.

lines.zh: 可是那一鍋的列印紙都正常，包內指示卡也都變色了。會不會是指示劑本身的問題？
lines.en: But that load's printout was normal and every internal card changed colour. Could the indicator itself be faulty?

q.zh: 三號鍋生物指示劑陽性，其他指示都正常。你怎麼做？
q.en: Sterilizer three's biological indicator is positive; everything else looks normal. What now?

options.zh: 停用該鍋，召回並隔離那一鍋的所有包
options.en: Take it out of service; recall and quarantine every pack from the load

why.zh: 只有生物指示劑直接證明殺菌。其他指示的「通過」不能抵銷它。先召回，再查是不是假陽性。
why.en: Only the biological indicator directly proves killing; a pass elsewhere can't cancel it. Recall first, then investigate a false positive.

options.zh: 重新培養一次，確認了再召回

why.zh: 等待的時間裡，那一鍋的包正被送進開刀房和病房。查原因可以同時做，召回不能等。
why.en: While you wait, packs from that load are going into theatres and wards. Investigation can run in parallel; the recall can't wait.

options.zh: 只召回還沒拆的包，已送出的不追
options.en: Recall only unopened packs here; ignore those sent out

why.zh: 送出去的包更急：它們最接近病人。追溯系統就是為了找到它們。
why.en: The packs already sent out are the most urgent: they're closest to patients. That's what traceability is for.

post.zh: 召回不是丟臉，是系統在運作。我來，我們一起打電話。
post.en: A recall isn't a disgrace; it's the system working. I'm here; let's make the calls together.

note.zh: 每一通電話：時間、對象、結果

guide.zh: 用追溯系統找出每一包
guide.en: Trace every pack in the system

lines.zh: 螢幕上跳出三號鍋那一鍋的清單：二十幾包，送到開刀房、外科病房、門診換藥室。
lines.en: The screen lists sterilizer three's load: twenty-odd packs, sent to theatres, the surgical ward and the outpatient dressing room.

lines.zh: 電話很多，人會換班。下一班要知道你通知了誰、幾點、對方怎麼回。
lines.en: Lots of calls, and people change shifts. The next shift must know whom you called, when, and what they said.

lines.zh: 這題寫的是生命徵象的交班，原則完全一樣：通知對象、時間、待辦，一個都不能少。
lines.en: This exercise is about handing over vital signs, but the principle is identical: who was told, when, what's outstanding. Nothing left out.

post.zh: 我在白板上畫了一張表：單位、包號、通知時間、對方姓名、攔下或已使用。
post.en: I've drawn a table on the whiteboard: unit, pack number, time called, who answered, stopped or already used.

sub.zh: 第二台髖關節的器械組在召回名單上
sub.en: The hip set for the second case is on the recall list

lines.zh: 婉婷，我是消毒供應中心。第二台髖關節的器械組，條碼尾數在召回名單上，請先不要打開。
lines.en: Wan-ting, sterile services here. The instrument set for your second case, the hip, is on our recall list by barcode. Please don't open it.

lines.zh: 收到。包布打開之前，什麼都還來得及。你們有替代的嗎？
lines.en: Got it. Until the wrap is opened there's still time. Do you have a replacement?

lines.zh: 無菌庫房有一組上週二號鍋的，生物指示劑陰性。我請人現在送過去。
lines.en: The sterile store has one from sterilizer two last week, indicator negative. I'll send it over now.

lines.zh: 你看這盤。昨天下午的腹部手術，血乾在器械關節裡，像咖啡漬一樣。
lines.en: Look at this tray. Yesterday afternoon's abdominal case: blood dried into the box locks like coffee stains.

lines.zh: 知道為什麼去污區最熱嗎？因為大家的冷笑話都在這裡。
lines.en: Know why decontamination is the hottest room? All the cold jokes ended up here.

lines.zh: 沒洗乾淨的地方，蒸氣也碰不到。從使用點開始，順序排給我看。
lines.en: Where cleaning fails, steam can't reach. Start from the point of use and put the steps in order.

q.zh: 器械從使用到滅菌的順序
q.en: From use to sterilisation, in order

steps.zh: 使用點預清潔並保持濕潤
steps.en: Pre-clean at point of use; keep moist

steps.zh: 拆開、打開關節、浸泡清洗
steps.en: Disassemble, open joints, soak and clean

steps.zh: 放大燈下檢查與功能測試

steps.en: Pack against the list, then sterilise

post.zh: 病房那邊如果用完先噴保濕酵素，血就不會乾成這樣。我一直想做一張海報。
post.en: If the wards sprayed enzyme foam right after use, blood wouldn't dry like this. I keep meaning to make a poster.

lines.zh: 考你：喉頭鏡片、手術剪刀、血壓計袖帶，各要多乾淨？
lines.en: Quiz: a laryngoscope blade, surgical scissors, a blood pressure cuff. How clean must each be?

lines.zh: 剪刀進入無菌組織，要滅菌；鏡片碰黏膜，至少高層次消毒；袖帶只碰皮膚，清潔消毒就好。
lines.en: Scissors enter sterile tissue: sterilise. The blade touches mucosa: at least high-level disinfection. The cuff touches skin: clean and disinfect.

lines.zh: 斯伯丁分類。可是三種的第一步都一樣——
lines.en: Spaulding classification. But all three share the same first step—

lines.zh: 先洗乾淨。
lines.en: Clean it first.

note.zh: 清單少一把：追到病人身上
note.en: One short on the list: trace it to the patient

lines.zh: 昨天下午那盤腹部器械，清單上是兩把長的止血鉗。盤子裡只有一把。
lines.en: Yesterday afternoon's abdominal tray: the list says two long haemostats. There's only one in the tray.

lines.zh: 開刀房的清點紀錄寫「正確」。那第二把在哪裡？
lines.en: The theatre count record says “correct”. So where is the second one?

lines.zh: 可能在布單裡、垃圾袋裡、另一盤裡。也可能，在病人身上。打給開刀房和主刀。
lines.en: In the linen, a rubbish bag, another tray. Or in the patient. Call theatres and the surgeon.

guide.zh: 看病人的腹部 X 光

lines.zh: 開刀房還在找。主刀說先照一張腹部 X 光，排除留在體內。片子出來了。
lines.en: Theatres are still searching. The surgeon has ordered an abdominal film to rule out a retained instrument. It's up.

question.zh: 清點紀錄正確，但器械清單少一把止血鉗。腹部 X 光要看什麼？如果沒看到，就結案了嗎？
question.en: The count was “correct” but the tray list is one haemostat short. What does the abdominal film look for, and if nothing shows, is it closed?

answer.zh: 金屬器械在 X 光上是清楚的白色形狀，紗布則靠裡面的顯影線。這張片子沒有看到任何器械，只有手術縫線和引流管。但結案要等找到那把鉗子，或確認它從未在這次手術使用；同時通報異常，檢討清點與器械清單為什麼對不上。
answer.en: A metal instrument shows as a sharp white shape on X-ray; swabs rely on their radio-opaque thread. This film shows no instrument, only sutures and a drain. But it isn't closed until the clamp is found or shown never to have been in that case; meanwhile file an incident report and review why the count and the tray list disagreed.

post.zh: 找到了！在開刀房的布單袋裡，捲在一條手術巾裡面。
post.en: Found it! In a theatre linen bag, rolled up inside a towel.

note.zh: 全套防護、沒吃早餐、站起來就倒
note.en: Full PPE, no breakfast, down on standing

lines.zh: 阿龍脫下防護衣走出去污區，說了一句「好熱」，扶著門框慢慢滑坐到地上，臉色發白。
lines.en: Long steps out of decontamination, peels off his gown, says “so hot”, then slides down the door frame to the floor, grey-faced.

options.zh: 讓他躺平抬腳、脫掉防護、量血壓血糖、叫人
options.en: Lie him flat, legs up, remove kit, check pressure and glucose, call help

why.zh: 熱、脫水、沒吃東西，加上突然站起來，最常是血管迷走或姿勢性低血壓。先讓腦有血，再找原因。
why.en: Heat, dehydration, no food and standing suddenly usually mean a vasovagal or postural drop. Get blood to the brain, then look for causes.

options.en: Help him up and walk him to the break room

why.zh: 血壓低的人站起來會再倒一次，而且可能撞到頭。
why.en: Stand him up with low pressure and he'll go down again, maybe hitting his head.

options.zh: 給他一杯冰水，叫他繼續上班
options.en: Give him iced water and send him back to work

why.zh: 昏倒要評估，不是撐過去。還要確認不是心律不整。
why.en: A faint needs assessment, not toughing out. An arrhythmia must be excluded too.

post.zh: ……我只是想說，去污區的冷笑話終於把我冷倒了。
post.en: …I just wanted to say the decon jokes finally knocked me cold.

lines.zh: 你剛剛在他一坐下就量了一次，現在躺了幾分鐘又量一次。兩次不一樣，哪一次比較能用？
lines.en: You measured as soon as he sat down, and again after a few minutes lying flat. They differ; which one can you use?

post.zh: 兩次都記下，寫清楚條件：剛倒下時坐著量、躺平休息後再量。休息後的回升了，血糖偏低。
post.en: Record both with their conditions: sitting just after the fall, and lying after rest. After rest it's recovered; glucose is on the low side.

lines.zh: 昏倒一定要做一張心電圖。胸前導程，位置要準。
lines.en: A faint always gets an ECG. Chest leads, placed precisely.

post.zh: 竇性心律，沒有異常。吃點東西、喝水、今天不准再進去污區。我會通報員工健康。
post.en: Sinus rhythm, nothing abnormal. Food, water, and no more decontamination today. I'll notify occupational health.
Then I'll draw the poster sitting down.

note.zh: 召回攔住了；濕包退回重做
note.en: The recall caught it; the wet pack goes back

lines.zh: 報告：髖關節那組早上就換掉了，召回的那組沒打開。黃阿公的手術準時開始，剛剛順利結束。
lines.en: Update: the hip set was swapped this morning; the recalled one was never opened. Grandpa Huang's operation started on time and has just finished well.

lines.zh: 名單上二十幾包，全部攔下或確認未使用。三號鍋查出來是那一鍋裝得太滿，蒸氣進不去中間。
lines.en: All twenty-odd packs on the list were stopped or confirmed unused. Sterilizer three: that load was packed too tightly and steam couldn't reach the middle.

lines.zh: 電話來的時候，髖關節那組已經打開放在器械台上了。還好還沒碰到病人。整台換新的，延遲快一個小時。
lines.en: When your call came, the hip set was already open on the back table. Luckily nothing had touched the patient. Everything was replaced; nearly an hour's delay.

lines.zh: 黃阿公在手術室外面多等了一個小時，很緊張。召回如果早上就做，這一小時不必發生。
lines.en: Grandpa Huang waited an extra hour outside theatre, frightened. Had the recall gone out this morning, that hour needn't have happened.

lines.zh: 查原因可以同時做，召回不能等。記住今天這一個小時。
lines.en: Investigation runs in parallel; the recall can't wait. Remember this hour.

sub.zh: 換藥包摸起來濕濕的，能不能用？
sub.en: The dressing pack feels damp. Is it usable?

lines.zh: 換藥包外面的指示膠帶有變色，可是包布摸起來濕濕的。可以用嗎？
lines.en: The indicator tape on the dressing pack has changed colour, but the wrap feels damp. Can I use it?

lines.zh: 不行。濕包一律當作污染，請退回來，從無菌庫房拿一包新的。膠帶變色只代表它經過了滅菌鍋。
lines.en: No. A wet pack is always treated as contaminated; send it back and take a fresh one from the sterile store. The tape only says it went through the sterilizer.

lines.zh: 無菌看的是事件，不是天數。濕了、破了、掉地上了，就不是無菌。這叫事件相關無菌。
lines.en: Sterility depends on events, not days. Damp, torn or dropped, and it isn't sterile. That's event-related sterility.

note.zh: 看不見的細菌，靠看得見的紀錄抓住
note.en: Invisible germs caught by visible records

guide.zh: 交班並聽魏護理長的結語
guide.en: Hand over; hear Sister Wei's debrief

lines.zh: 三號鍋停用，重新測試合格前不使用；召回名單全部有通知紀錄；止血鉗已找回；阿龍已轉員工健康。
lines.en: Sterilizer three out of service until it retests clean; every recall call is logged; the haemostat is back; Long referred to occupational health.

lines.zh: 今天三件事：生物指示劑陽性先當真；每一通電話要留下時間和名字；洗不乾淨，就滅不乾淨。
lines.en: Three things today: a positive biological indicator is real until proven otherwise; every call leaves a time and a name; what isn't cleaned can't be sterilised.

lines.zh: 你今天沒有碰到一個病人，可是你照顧了二十幾個。
lines.en: You didn't touch a single patient today, yet you looked after twenty-odd of them.

lines.zh: 白板旁邊多了一張手畫的海報：「用完先噴保濕，阿龍感謝您。」
lines.en: Beside the whiteboard, a hand-drawn poster has appeared: “Spray enzyme foam after use. Love, Long.”

note.en: Fast is not a shortcut: check the store first

sub.zh: 急診刀，唯一一把血管鉗掉地上了
sub.en: Emergency case: the only vascular clamp hit the floor

lines.zh: 夜間急診刀，唯一一把血管鉗掉到地上了！可以幫我們快速滅菌一下嗎？
lines.en: Emergency case tonight, and our only vascular clamp just hit the floor! Can you do a quick sterilise?

lines.zh: 先查無菌庫房和追溯系統。另一盤血管器械裡有同一型號，生物指示劑陰性，現在送過去。
lines.en: Checking the sterile store and the tracking system first. Another vascular tray has the same model, indicator negative. Sending it now.

lines.zh: 太好了。掉地上的那把呢？
lines.en: Brilliant. And the one on the floor?

lines.zh: 走正常流程：去污、檢查、包裝、滅菌。快速滅菌只在真的沒有替代、依院內規定時才用，植入物永遠不行。
lines.en: Normal route: decontaminate, inspect, pack, sterilise. Immediate-use sterilising is only for when there's truly no alternative, per hospital policy, and never for implants.

lines.zh: 你推著器械車走出無菌庫房。走廊盡頭，海報上阿龍畫的小人在對你比讚。
lines.en: You wheel the tray out of the sterile store. At the end of the corridor, the little figure on Long's poster gives you a thumbs-up.

sub.zh: 沒碰到一個病人，卻照顧了二十幾個
sub.en: Not one patient touched, twenty-odd cared for
